items.title: Moody's (MCO) Stock Looks Expensive On Excess Returns
items.summary: Moody's has ridden a strong multi year share price upswing, and that kind of climb naturally raises the question of whether the business is earning enough on its capital to support a valuation at this level. For anyone considering the stock today, the key issue is how closely the current price lines up with the returns the company generates on the money it invests back into the business. items.title: Moody’s Pilot With Chainlink Puts Test Ratings on Several Blockchains in One Pass
items.summary: Moody's has so far added its ratings engine one blockchain at a time. This time the companies sent the same stand-in ratings to several chains at once, a trial with no real rating actions that ran only on test networks.

items.title: Moody’s Taps Chainlink to Send Credit Ratings Across Multiple Blockchains
items.summary: The testnet pilot used Chainlink’s CCIP to distribute Moody’s ratings simultaneously across permissioned and permissionless blockchains, while preserving the firm’s existing publication and governance processes.

items.title: Moody’s and S&P downgrade Akamai on debt-fueled AI infrastructure buildout
items.summary: Investing.com -- Akamai Technologies Inc (NASDAQ:AKAM) saw its credit profile take a significant hit on Monday as both Moody’s Ratings and S&P Global Ratings downgraded the company following its decision to raise over $2 billion in convertible debt to pre-fund an aggressive push into artificial intelligence edge infrastructure.
